capabilities: find every external link in the current note
submit links to an archive service
embed an archived link after the original link
skip links that are already archived
extras: Support for other archive providers is listed as a future plan, so it currently works with one provider; archive links break if their formatting is modified.
problem: External links in notes can die when sites go down or remove pages, leaving notes pointing at lost content.
summary: Link archiver that submits every external link in the current note to an archive service and embeds an archived copy next to it.
